args.description: the fortified wall of Bronze Age Troy seen from directly in front, strict flat side profile like a technical elevation drawing. Cyclopean masonry of huge irregular pale limestone blocks, the wall base sloping outward in a broad batter and the upper part standing vertical. Two square towers with FLAT tops and a low plain parapet of squared stone. Between them a square-headed gateway spanned by one massive timber lintel beam, with tall wooden doors of vertical planks below it. Small red banners on plain poles. Warm sunlit palette of pale limestone, sand and bronze. Retro 16-bit pixel art, crisp pixels, flat readable shapes, no anti-aliasing.
